description: This file contains unit tests for the BaseVoidHandler class, verifying its behavior in handling voiding (deletion/archiving) of 'Voidable' entities such as Person objects, within the OpenMRS medical record system. The tests check setting of voided status, void reason, voided by user, and date voided, including edge cases where fields are pre-set.

classes.name: BaseVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class testing the behavior of BaseVoidHandler's handle method for Voidable entities, ensuring proper setting of voided status, reason, user, and date.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheVoidedBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method sets the 'voided' flag to true.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheVoidReason
methods.description: Tests that the handle method correctly sets the void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetVoidedBy
methods.description: Ensures that the handle method sets the 'voidedBy' user when not already set.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetVoidedByIfNonNull
methods.description: Verifies that if 'voidedBy' is already set, it is not overwritten.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetDateVoided
methods.description: Checks that the date voided is set by the handle method.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetDateVoidedIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that if 'dateVoided' is already set, it is not overwritten.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetTheVoidReasonIfAlreadyVoided
methods.description: Checks that the void reason is not updated if the entity is already marked as voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetVoidedByEvenIfVoidedBitIsSetButVoidedByIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method sets the 'voidedReason' even if 'voided' is already true but 'voidedBy' is null.
